    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.factor_to_generated_from_bongartz (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P Q : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (hQ : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose X) → Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose X)) {I : FGModuleCat R} (hI : IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) I) (f : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ I) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ ⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) (b : (⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) ⟶ I), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a b = f

    Every map from the Bongartz cokernel to a quotient of copies of the original cokernel factors through a finite sum of that original cokernel.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_bongartz_end_quotient (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P Q : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (hb : Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential))) (hQ : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose X) → Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose X)) (gen : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose X) → IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) X) :
    ∃ (G : FGModuleCat R) (p : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ G), CategoryTheory.Epi p ∧ (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable G ∧ (∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable X → IsGeneratedBy G X) ∧ (∀ {X Y : FGModuleCat R} (q : X ⟶ Y) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable X → (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable Y → ∀ (f : G ⟶ Y), ∃ (a : G ⟶ X), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a q = f) ∧ ∃ (φ : CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) →+* CategoryTheory.End G), Function.Surjective ⇑φ ∧ (∀ (f : CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p (φ f) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f p) ∧ ∀ (f : CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential)), φ f = 0 ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ ⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) (b : (⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a b = f

    The semistable projective generator is the trace quotient of a Bongartz cokernel. Its endomorphism ring is the quotient by all maps that factor through the additive closure of the original cokernel.
